events.content: how do we publish a release with publish-npm.yml on tag push?

Releases go through publish-npm.yml on tag push.
Push the version tag v2.4.17 and watch the run with gh run watch.
Never run npm publish locally; the workflow adds provenance.

The vector outbox drain stalls when the worker lock is held by a dead pid.
doctor --fix clears the stale worker lock and the drain resumes.

SessionStart grounding fell from 0.081 to 0.008 after PR #55 replaced the ranking.
PR #57 restored the ranking and overlap recovered to 0.19.

The markdown mirror test is flaky only under full suite load.
Rerun tests/core/markdown-mirror.test.ts alone before retrying a release.

The dashboard theme now follows the system color scheme.
Dark mode tokens live in the theme stylesheet.
gh run watch 1234 publish-npm.yml completed successfully
How do I publish a release with publish-npm.yml on tag push?

Push the version tag and let publish-npm.yml run on tag push.
Watch the run with gh run watch; never run npm publish locally.
Why does the vector outbox drain stall with a held worker lock?

A dead pid still holds the worker lock, so the vector outbox drain stalls.
Run doctor --fix to clear the stale worker lock.

Spec for the billing ledger rollback. Goal: when a migration fails halfway, the billing ledger must roll back to the last checkpoint. Constraints: no data loss, idempotent retries, and an audit row per rollback. Out of scope: currency conversion. How should the billing ledger rollback work?

Billing ledger rollback: restore the last checkpoint inside one transaction.
Retries are idempotent through the rollback audit row keyed by migration id.
